note: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.
Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.
Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Lendeborg is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Kings with an illness.

LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

Fox (shin) is questionable to play Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game in Portland.
